balls.text: stands and whacks again, straight down to long-on this time, the fielder can't get to it and that's 24 off the over, fine flourish to end it all from Misbah
low full toss again and Misbah can't time that, lofted to long-on where AB de Villiers drops a tough chance, it was dipping on him and he makes a hash of it, things not going well here
slower but but Misbah knows that, stand and deliver that, waits for it and swings it hard over midwicket for a six, he knew exactly what was coming
another biggie, waits back, knows that the yorker will be tried and blisters that over cover for six, he's a king at this format and it's finally showing
that's gold-dust at this point, a dot ball, Misbah lets it go thinking it's a wide but not called, Zaheer Khan is halfway down the crease and needs to hurry back
that's gone way into the midwicket stand, low full toss from Bhatia and Misbah is waiting there, juicy full-toss that's crashed hard into the crowds at midwicket
another yorker-length ball but Zaheer is upto it, moves across, takes it on the full and tucks it past short fine leg for a four, that was sensible

sensational bowling this, as lovely a set-up as it gets, short one followed by yorkers, Kumar was softened up early and had no answer to this one - full and swinging into him, he's rooted to the crease and sees the base of off stump being rattled. That's why he's the master.
yorker length again, Kumar can't get that out, back to the bowler, that's how you want to keep them in the end
shuffling across, standing ready to swivel it square but that's full and outside off, tonked hard to long-off but only a single
full this time, dug out towards long-on for a single, Misbah needs to do the big striking now

what a corker, this was a ball that would have been good for a Test match, short of a length, directed at his throat, Kumar on his front foot but the ball was going towards the jaws there, pops up close to the batsman
swinging full toss, attempted yorker but he can't get it right, pushed to long-off, fine spell from Maharoof, 2 for 13 from 4 overs.
spanked to deep point and they pick up a single, on his knees that time, Misbah

another run-out, this is just not what you want at the slog, short one that Misbah can't get away, top edge trickles to extra cover, and Misbah doesn't want a run, Akhil is too far down and Maharoof completes a simple run-out
makes room and hammers down to long-off
short and outside off, on his toes and angling to third man
quickfire pull from Akhil but Dhawan has pulled off a fantastic save in the midwicket boundary, that was on its way for four but he's dived full length to save three runs
that's typical Misbah, stands tall and spanks a full one straight down the ground for four, that was juddered superbly, Sangwan's three overs cost 51 runs, a night to forget
and he's teed off, that was too short and he's waiting for the pull on the back foot, blitzed away high over square leg for six, that was too easy
yorker again, tries to work it away but only manages an inside edge onto his pads, quick single
good yorker this time, quicker and Misbah can't do much with that
backs away and lashes it to extra cover for a couple
slower one to start with, Misbah too early on it

disaster this time, fine fielding from Shoaib Malik at long-on and there's a reckless run-out for White, Misbah cracks it to long-off and Malik needed to decide whether to go for the catch or simply stop it, he decided to go for the safer option, picked up and threw it in fast, White wanted the second but Misbah hesitated, the ball went to Maharoof and he threw it to the keeper to take the bails off, White was too far down by then. This is a big wicket, he can really biff it towards the end
similar ball, cramps him for room and they need to make do with a tip to the on side and a run
short one again, this pitch has got fizzy, on his toes and pushing back down the ground, this is a good length from Maharoof
yorker this time, dug out to mid-off, Maharoof tries to stop it but can't get there

super ball, short of a length and Misbah tries to angle it to third man, that drizzle seems to have spiced the pitch up, huge appeal from Karthik behind the stumps but it's not given, the bowler didn't go up straight away

down the track and tries to clear the midwicket region, bit of extra bounce for Maharoof and the leading edge pops high in the air for Dilshan, at point, to take a comfortable catch. End of a fine innings
short of a length, tapped back to the bowler, Misbah needs to get a move on here
short this time, on his toes and glides it to third man
tries to nudge to the off side, moves away from the seam and is beaten

top edge flies away past Karthik, he's tried to lash it past cover but can only get an edge, that would have been a sensational catch but it races past Karthik for four, Goswami brings up a fifty in his IPL debut, take a bow little man, they'll be cheering in Lilua (his hometown in Bengal) for sure
driven hard to point, Dilshan isn't letting anything go by, two vital dots for Yomahesh
good length ball, thumped to cover but can't get the run
slow and outside off, tries to cut but is too quick on it, misses
punched to mid-off, quick single but he doesn't pick it up cleanly
slow bouncer but Sreevats is in the zone now, backs away and is ready with the pull, over midwicket for four, that's a cracking shot
moves back and across, thinks of the hoick over midwicket but it's too full and outside off, angled towards third man
walks across and works it away to fine leg for a single, mature knock from Sreevats so far
slightly short and he's latched on, quick movement back and the pull shot is ripped hard, speeds to the square fence for four
shuffles across the stumps this time, trying to beat short fine leg, but that's a slower one that he needs to wait for, can't get the placement right, straight to the fielder at short fine
backs away again and brings out the delicate steer to third man, cutely done, but good diving stop on the boundary line
another tip and run to the off side, Misbah's plan seems clear, get into the groove and smash later
yorker gone wrong this time, full toss outside off, driven hard to deep point for a single
backs off again and tries to judder it past cover but misses again, this is getting frustrating for Goswami
gives himself a lot of room and that's called a wide, harsh one that, it wouldn't have been a wide if he was standing in his normal position
short of a length, stands back and patted away to the off side
short one, pulled away crisply but there's a fielder who comes around quickly, they're kept down to two
outside off and not much movement, steered to third man for a single, Misbah getting into his groove there
tucked away towards square leg, they think of a couple but that's good fielding
patted to cover for a quick single
pitched on middle and leg, flicked to square leg
jags back into him, beaten that time
he's got 'em, that was a quicker one and there wasn't much spin there, Dravid tries to heave it over midwicket but that's through the gate and rattles the stump, the Dilshan plan has worked
quicker one, he makes room and cracks it hard past extra cover, there's a fielder back there, though
tries to punch to mid-on but can't get the timing right
down the track and turned away past midwicket for a single, a typical Dravid shot
looks to back away and cut but that bounces a bit more to beat him, jumps on the keeper
tapped away to short third man for a quick one
full and on off, Goswami is waiting to get some elevation but pushes to mid-off for a single
third man in place now, cut away past point again but McGrath keeps them down to just one
finally he's got it, pushed off the front foot and gets it past point all the way for four, that's well timed and he's broken the shackles
slower this time, 101kph, slightly shorter and wide too, Dravid's bat comes down too quick, that was close to a wide but not called, three dots in a row
beaten again, outside off and moving away again, tries to cut again but misses again
slower one outside off, swinging away, Dravid tries to cut off the front foot but is beaten
short but it's not too wide, cut straight to Dilshan again
Dilshan on the prowl again, Goswami charges forward and pushes to point but the fielder is diving around as if this is a gymnastic ring, can't get it past him
slower one this time, slightly short too, Goswami tries to angle it past the first slip (that's just come in for this over) but can't get the timing right
tip and run again, jabbed to the covers and takes off
driven powerfully to mid-off, the fielder is back on the boundary and they pick off the single
pushed to mid-on and takes off, sensible decision to give Goswami the strike, he's the man in form

that's cute, the boy in him comes out, short of a length and outside off, he waits for it till the last moment and angles his bat neatly, past the keeper to third man this time, that was done with the tenderness of a kiss, Goswami on a roll now
this is getting worse, short and down leg again, Goswami is ready with the pull and lashes that hard to fine leg, that's too easy for the batsman
on the pads and tucked away neatly past the keeper for four, Sangwan not getting this right and his Under-19 team-mate Goswami is making the most of it
better line this time, slightly fuller length too, batsman tries to cut but can't find enough room, misses that one
smash hit, short and Goswami is ready with the pull, on his back foot (though he's out of the crease) and pulls ferociously over midwicket for six, that's a super hit
full and outside off, driven straight to cover, Goswami struggling a bit, he's played a few good shots but missing more than striking
down the track and spanked away over infield for a single, Maharoof rounds off a fine over
that's straighter, cramps him for room and he can't get the backfoot drive away, fine start by Mahafoor
lashes outside off but that's a good length again, misses that and it flies quick to the keeper
short of a length, nearly reaching Goswami's throat that, he's on his toes and punching towards point
on middle stump, Dravid moves across and works it away to fine leg for a single

strikes straight away, full and wide, big outside edge as Kallis tries to drive hard and that's a sharp diving catch by Dinesh Karthik behind the stumps, latches onto and important catch and Steve Davis raises his finder this time
short of a length and tapped towards short third man
now that's a sweet shot, laced through the covers for a fine four, everything right about it, balance, timing and head position
punched off the back foot, straight to covers
angled to third man, seems to be racing away for four but Sangwan throws himself to his right and pulls off a fine save, keeps them down to two
outside off this time and lets it go, two good dot balls from Yomahesh
full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler
on middle and Kallis moves across to turn it away crisply off his hips, all the way behind square for four, McGrath is furious - this time with himself

got 'em, he's got his man now, short one again and Chipli can't hold back from the pull, the top edge flies high and Rajat Bhatia nearly makes a meal of the skier running back towards midwicket, he slips before taking the catch but holds on despite the tumble. McGrath isn't celebrating - he tells Chipli to stay on and gestures, 'Not out, not out'. He was really peeved with that edge not being given as out.
that's spanked hard to point and some sensational fielding by Dilshan, diving stop after throwing himself to the right, McGrath gives the batsman more lip, he is furious now
bouncer this time, he's pretty annoyed now, accurate one and Chipli can't pull it quick enough, that's the bouncer for the over
short of a length and that is a typical McGrath length, moves away from Chipli and he gives him a bit of lip, knows he got an edge in the previous over
walks down the ground, pushes to mid-on, direct hit from Rajat Bhatia but Kallis is home

that's harsh from the umpire, it was not too wide outside off but it's called a wide, Kallis let it go and McGrath can't believe it, he wasn't given a caught-behind in the last ball of the previous over and now this. Surely no love lost between the Aussies.
punched off the back foot to third man, they think of two but the fielder is quick, some damage control by Yomahesh after Sangwan's expensive over
more swing, pitched on a good length and moving away, Kallis tries to drive on one knee but misses that one, there's a bit of nip in the air for sure
walks across his stumps and tries to flick it away but that raps him on the pads, huge appeal for lbw but the umpire isn't interested, he was down the track and maybe that tilted the balance
driven crisply, full and on middle stump and he's rattled that past the bowler for four, text-book perfect that
good-length ball, driven firmly to the covers
on the pads again, this seems to be a trend for the day, pushed firmly in the midwicket gap for a couple

that appeared like a huge edge but umpire Steve Davis doesn't give it, pitched short of a length, moved away, Chipli flashes and that appeared to have taken the outside edge, but the umpire stands firm. McGrath and the rest can't believe it.
pushed back on the back foot, can't beat the field
flicked away to the on side, line slightly wrong that time
worked away to point that time, straight to the bowler
short of a length, that's the master's length, no room to play with there, pushed back to the bowler
down the leg side and angled towards fine leg
short of a length, outside off, left alone, this was an expensive over - 19 off it
short one again, this is too easy for Kallis, stands tall and spanks that way over square leg for a big six
short that time and that's skied high to the on side, short of a length and top-edge soars over the in-field
he's lost his bearings here, too wide again, the line is all wrong
pushed straight down the ground for a quick single
driven on the up off the back foot, rocks back and finds the gap on the off side, races away for four, this is turning out to be a good over for Bangalore
too wide again, he's sprayed that, too far for the wicketkeeper as well, all the way for four, this is erratic from Sangwan
short of a length, tapped off the back foot towards cover
too wide outside off, starting wide and moving away, Kallis throws his bat but can't reach it, wide called and rightly so
short and outside off, he weaves out of the way of that one, that could have easily been a maiden if not for Pigeon's overthrow
driven fluently away from the body but AB de Villiers is prowling in the covers and pulls off a super save, he's one of the best around
walks down the track and pushes back to the bolwer, McGrath lets out a reverse flick that hits the stumps and deflects for an overthrow, they get a run.
he reaches out for this one, plays and misses, moves away from the bat in the last moment, bit of seam movement here
outside off again, left alone, Bharat Chipli is Kallis' opening partner
starts with one slightly wide, Kallis is the latest in the line of openers for Banglalore. They seem to have changed their combination every game.
all over now, full and on middle and he's swung that way over long-off for a biggie, that was as smooth as a pendulum and Dhawan sets off the celebrations.
full toss, that was an attempted yorker but Dhawan was a bit surprised by it, pushed to mid-off
short again, pulled away to Kumar at deep square leg, keeps the strike, they just need 3 now
backs away, tries to pull it over the infield and gets the short midwicket fielder, Dhawan, by the way, completed 300 runs in the tournament with that four
straight and coming into the left-hander, he tries to loft it over mid-on but a thick inside edge has sneaked the gap between mid-on and midwicket, all the way for four, all over bar the shouting now
full on off, driven but straight to Kallis at short extra-cover
yorker this time, Zaheer goes over the wicket now, Maharoof backs away again and drives confidently through point for a single
what a statement! Maharoof dances down the track and rips a powerful drive through the covers, that's pinged the boundary hoardings hard and they're almost there now
backs away again but Steyn follows him, struck on the body but they manage a leg bye, end of a ferocious spell but Delhi could just get past the tape here
yorker this time, he backs away again but does well to dig it out in the last moment

Huge! Maharoof turns it on when it matters, backs away and blasts a short one way over backward point for six, he's held his nerve under pressure here and come up with a super shot, that's eased the pressure
slower one from Steyn, Dhawan is foxed by it and the tentative chip falls in the gap in the covers, that could have easily been caught
good length ball outside off, that's speedy too, Dhawan smashes one straight into the ground and point stops that over his head, the crowd thinks it's a catch but that clearly bounced on the ground
yorker on middle and leg, Maharoof stands back and pushes to the leg side, tension enveloping the ground now

more drama! Dhawan pushes back to the bowler, it appeared like a bump ball but Kumble completed a low catch and claims it, the fielders look pretty confident but the umpire is not sure, the third umpire is called upon but the evidence is not conclusive. "Not out" says the third umpire
quicker one on middle, turned away to the leg side for a quick single, good fielding at square leg but they're home
full on middle, Maharoof drives it cautiously to mid-on, no run though

got 'em! another one for Kumble. This is turning into a humdinger. Loopy legbreak outside off, Karthik pushes tentatively and that's uppish, Cameron White is a fine fielder and he throws himself at cover to complete a sharp catch, Kumble gets one more. Bangalore is abuzz
fine shot under pressure, on the back foot and cut away behind square, Zaheer can't get there and that's raced away for four
full and outside off, that was the googly and he decided to sweep against the turn, straight to Kumar at deep midwicket
147.9kph, speedy and short, Dhawan gets on the back foot and pulls it in a controlled fashion for a single, well done there
full on middle and leg, turned to fine leg, this is tight now
pitched on off, cut away past point for a single
pitched on lg, Karthik flicks it off his pads to square leg

got 'em, that's a big wicket, could there be a twist in the tale? Steyn gets one short of a length and it's speedy, too close to the stumps there and AB tries to cut one that's too close to him, top-edge flies to the keeper and Bangalore are cock-a-hoop
full swinging one on middle, driven fluently to mid-off
paddle sweep to fine leg for a single
full and outside off, driven neatly behind point for a single

brilliant bit of bowling and equally smart piece of stumping from Goswami, Dilshan tries to heave one over midwicket after dancing down the track but Kumble beats him with a legbreak that turns and bounces, Goswami plucks the ball from wide of the stumps and pulls off a quicksilver stumping. Dilshan tries to get back but the bat is in the air when the bails are whipped off. Third umpire says 'Out' and rightly so
full and punched hard to long-on for a single
Dilshan makes room and drives through the covers
quicker one down the leg side, AB was giving him the charge but he made the late change Kumble, AB needs to make the change to push to the on side
flicked to square leg for a single
short one but he's done in by the bounce, deflects off the keeper for a single bye
another blinding effort from Chipli but he can't get to it, it's chipped towards him at point but the ball bounces just short of him
on the pads, he tries to work it to the on side but only gets a deflection to covers, they think of a quick single but sensibly decide against it
short of a length, cracked to cover off the back foot
defended watchfully to point, good over from Kumble but the game might have just slipped away
another loopy one, tries to thump it through the off side but only manages an inside edge to mid-on
tossed up slightly, Dilshan waits for it and punches off the back foot towards covers
driven meatily through the covers for a single
quicker one, waits on the back foot and pushed back to the covers
chips down the track and works the full-toss away to the leg side
slower one, ends up as a low full toss, driven fluently through the covers
short of a length, pushed to mid-on and they hurry a quick single
a bit too short, thumped away hard to deep point
prodded to short third man
uppish this time, outside off but point can't get to it despite a diving attempt, they complete two more, these Delhi batsmen are so quick between the wickets
on the pads and tucked away easily for a couple, in front of square and the throw is not accurate
good legbreak outside off, prods tentatively but beaten
full again, quicker through the air too, pushed back to the bowler
driven to mid-on for an easy single
too full and outside off, cracked powerfully through the extra-cover gap for four, struck sweetly that time, fielder can't reach it
short of a length, tapped away to the off side but another dot
full and on off, driven carefully to mid-on

that's a risky second and he's paid for it! slashed away to deep point and they think of two but Cameron White is quick, he unleashes an accurate throw and Gambhir is well short of his crease, Sreevats whips the bails off quickly, Gambhir doesn't even wait for a decision, runs all the way back
short of a length, jagging back into the left-hander, cut away but Chipli pulls off another fine save, he's prowling there
a bit short and outside off, tapped away past point, cheekily done, Zaheer is a bit slow and they scamper back for a couple
full and outside off, tapped to deep point for a single
on middle and leg, turned away to square leg for a single, sensible from Gauti, he knows the run-rate is well within control
full and outside off, driven straight to cover
straight one again, tucked to fine leg and he hurries back for two, that was a bit sloppy from the fielder
135.6kph, outside off and moving away, AB tries to tap it past the slips but is beaten
tapped and takes off for a quick single, cramped for room there, that brings up 500 runs for Gauti in the tournament, nobody has reached 400 yet, he's on a roll here
too close to cut and he nearly played onto to the stumps there, thick inside edge bounced close to the stumps and nearly went over the keeper but good take from Goswami
tapped to short third man, quick single, he's a hare between the wickets
short of a length, glided to third man for a single

what a catch! It required a moment of brlliance to end this knock. Short of a length and outside off, he rocks back and crunches it hard towards point but Chipli pulls off a sensational diving catch, lunging full-length to his left and completes the catch when still horizontal. That's the breakthrough but is it too late?
short again, pulls again but the inside edge nearly goes on to knock back the stumps, races away past the stumps for four to fine leg

ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Sehwag's world, short again (how silly is that?) and pulled away nonchalantly over square leg for six, bread and butter that. Sehwag equals Jayasuriya for the most sixes in the tournament (20)
he's in cruise control now, short again and that's pulled away with immense power, too easy for Sehwag, he's eager for an early finish
that's cheeky but he was waiting for that, short and he's sliced that over the wicketkeeper for four, too easy for Sehwag, he has patented that shot and plays it even in Test cricket
down the track and driven to cover, good diving stop keeps them down to a single, that was travelling too

that's the most furious shot of the day, short again and Sehwag stood there expecting it, rocked back and pulverised a pull so hard that fielders could only watch transfixed, this was a brutal one. One bounce to midwicket for four
short and he ducks under that one
on the pads again, it's amazing how many times the bowlers have erred in line here, tapped for a single
steered to third man, there's a misfield there but they settle for one
that's a beauty, punched off the back foot and it's raced through covers for four, that was just a little tip, it seemed, but Sehwag packs a punch when he strikes them, they're motoring now
cut away off the back foot to third man, this appears too easy
he's motoring along too, on middle and leg and Sehwag punishes that behind square, these two batsmen have murdered attacks all through this tournament and this doesn't look any different
sensible this time, taps with soft hands and takes off for a single to cover
on the pads again and Gambhir is demoralising him here, clipped sweetly in front of square for a four, he's toying with the bowling now

short of a length there, stands back and tries to loft over the infield but can't get the timing right, chipped towards mid-on and take off for a single, direct hit attempted but he can't get it right, that could have been a close shave for Sehwag
down the leg side, tries to work it around but it's struck on the pads and they scramble one
but it's too full and too wide and Gambhir latches on without any fuss, on the front foot and a text-book perfect cover drive through the gap, he is in the zone now
on the up and he's pulped that hard, not a bad ball but Sehwag is so good with these shots through the line, on the back foot and gives mid-off no chance
too close to cut, short of a length and he tries to go for the upper cut past slip, can't make contact
typical Viru, full and outside off, chipped effortlessly over the infield for four, that was struck with some ease, boom it went
it's all messed up now, drifting down the pads and Sehwag helps it along to fine leg for four, the left-right combination is messing with the bowlers here
on middle and off, keeps him quiet now, pushed to the off side for a quick single, better line from Zaheer here
sensible from the captain, steering to third man and giving the strike to the man in form

bit of width and he's flayed that through the covers for another four, he's in such roaring form that a few good balls can only stiffen him up, what a zinger that was, four dots and two fours, Gauti makes up for lost time
one of the best straight drives you will see on the night, full and straight, Gambhir shows what fine balance he possesses, crisp drive down the ground, and shows the markers name superbly
scorcher this time, short of a length, holding its line there, Gambhir prods tentatively but is beaten, four dot balls here, priceless
good follow up from Steyn, following the bouncer by a full one that's angled outside off, moves away from the left-hander, play and a miss
bouncer from Steyn, batsman ducks below it and it requires a leap from Goswami behind the stumps
short of a length, worked away to the off side, straight to the fielder
full on middle and leg, tapped to mid-on for a quick single
another one that's way too wide down leg, no chance for Goswami there, another four, more wides, this may be costly
tapped to the on side, cramped for room there
on the front foot and smashed through cover for a couple
135.7kph, full and outside off, good line then, Gambhir lets that one go, he's batting with supreme confidence here
too far down leg, that's an awful line from Zaheer, beats the batsman, beats the keeper, he can only get a glove to it but it's four
short of a length on middle and off, angled away to third man
too far down leg side, that's too easy for Gambhir, helped it down the leg side, four legbyes and Steyn hasn't got his line right
142.3kph, full and outside off, cracked away with some fine timing to cover, well fielded but what a shot, he's middling them like few others in this tournament
on middle and leg this time, turned away crisply behind square for a single
that's a brute of a ball, short and searing off the pitch, taking off there, that was speedy and Sehwag had no chance there, Goswami takes it high behind the stumps
tucked to square leg for a single, the line is a bit awry here
down the leg side and what a start from Gambhir, flicked with sweet timing to the square leg fence for four, too easy for the man with the orange cap
